data.one_liner: Mapbox MBTiles vector tile provider for flutter_map for offline maps
data.what_it_does: Provides a TileProvider for flutter_map that enables rendering vector tiles using MBTiles databases. It supports pbf/mvt formats for 100% offline map usage.
use_when: You need fully offline vector maps in your flutter_map application
You are using MBTiles files containing vector tiles (pbf/mvt format)
avoid_when: You need web support, as SQLite support is lacking on the web
You are using raster tiles instead of vector tiles
strengths: Enables 100% offline map rendering with vector_map_tiles and flutter_map
weaknesses: Not supported on the web platform due to lack of SQLite support
Requires proper local file read permissions
data.setup_notes: Requires file system read permission and the MBTiles file to be accessible on the device.
